SELECT p.sku, p.style_name, p.size, i.stock_count, i.reorder_point, i.last_restocked_at 
FROM products p 
JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku 
WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point 
AND i.last_restocked_at < date('now', '-7 days');
detections.insight: The data indicates a high risk of stockouts across various clothing products, with 11 out of 14 products having a stock count below the reorder point. This is particularly concerning for products like CL-00071 (Wool Blend Blazer, size XS) and CL-00068 (Wool Blend Blazer, size M), which have been out of stock for over 7 days. This stockout risk can lead to lost sales, customer dissatisfaction, and ultimately, a decline in revenue. Furthermore, the prolonged stockout duration for some products (e.g., CL-00065, CL-00068, and CL-00071) may indicate operational inefficiencies, such as delayed restocking or supply chain disruptions, which can have long-term consequences for the company's reputation and bottom line.
detections.recommendation: To mitigate this risk, I recommend that the executive: 1. **Prioritize urgent restocking of critical products**: Identify the most critical products with stock counts below the reorder point and expedite their restocking to minimize stockout duration and prevent lost sales. 2. **Conduct a thorough review of supply chain operations**: Investigate the root causes of the prolonged stockout duration for certain products and implement corrective actions to address any operational inefficiencies, such as delayed restocking or supply chain disruptions, to prevent similar issues in the future.

detections.sql:
SELECT p.sku, p.style_name, p.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, 
       (CASE 
            WHEN SUM(se.units_sold) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE SUM(i.stock_count) / (SUM(se.units_sold) * 4)
       END) AS turnover_rate
FROM products p
JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku
JOIN sales_events se ON p.sku = se.sku
JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
GROUP BY p.sku, p.style_name, p.supplier_id, s.supplier_name
HAVING (CASE 
            WHEN SUM(se.units_sold) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE SUM(i.stock_count) / (SUM(se.units_sold) * 4)
       END) < 4

These issues have the potential to impact business operations and revenue. Immediate action is required to mitigate these risks.

threat_vectors.description: 11 out of 14 products have a stock count below the reorder point, indicating a high risk of stockouts. Products like CL-00071 (Wool Blend Blazer, size XS) and CL-00068 (Wool Blend Blazer, size M) are particularly concerning.

threat_vectors.name: Sales Channel Performance Discrepancies
threat_vectors.description: Data analysis has revealed significant discrepancies in sales channel performance, with a risk score of 37 indicating a moderate risk.

threat_vectors.name: Inventory Turnover Rate Calculation Discrepancies
threat_vectors.description: The inventory turnover rate calculation has revealed discrepancies, with a risk score of 42 indicating a moderate risk.

immediate_actions: Conduct an emergency inventory audit to identify and rectify stockouts across all products, with a focus on CL-00071 and CL-00068.
Review and optimize sales channel performance to minimize discrepancies and ensure consistent revenue streams.
Re-run the inventory turnover rate calculation to identify and address any discrepancies, and adjust inventory management strategies accordingly.
Establish a task force to investigate and address the root causes of these issues, and implement corrective actions to prevent future occurrences.
monitoring_recommendations: Continuously monitor inventory levels and sales channel performance to detect any further discrepancies or anomalies.
Regularly review and update the inventory turnover rate calculation to ensure accuracy and identify potential risks.
